title: Enter the Spirit's garden and gather all virtues
english: So then, brothers and fathers, enter the Spirit's many-flowered garden and eagerly gather the virtues from it—not one, but many; or rather, not many, but all of them. For virtue needs virtue, just as wing needs wing, wheel needs wheel, step needs step, oar needs oar, and rudder needs rudder. If you do not join stone to stone, the tower will not rise to a height. In the same way, if we do not set commandment upon commandment, we will not reach heaven; if you do not join commandment to commandment, the course is incomplete.
translator_notes: The Greek text may be fragmented, and some sentences may be cut off at the edges.
The translation attempts to preserve the original sentence structure and wording as much as possible.
baehrens: PG 93; In sanctos martyres (Khazarzar) u01 open
orientation: The preacher opens his encomium by calling the congregation to enter the Spirit's garden and gather every virtue, not just one.
